title: Well-made baking cups but too small, too few, and too expensive
text:
Well-made baking cups but too small, too few, and too expensive. These baking cups are well made. However, they are SUPER small (like a 1/4 or 1/3 cup size) and that is their biggest drawback besides the exorbitant $24.99 price and only getting three cups when six are really needed to be useful.

I ordered these for my 6 QT Ninja Foodi. These are good both for that appliance and the Instant Pot. Since these are so small, they "get lost" in the Foodi as it looks like I am baking nothing. I used these to experiment with making popovers in my Foodi on the bake cycle. Although the results looked like miniature turkeys (last photo), they came out well. However, they did stick to the sides even though I greased the cups and it was a lot of work to clean. Nevertheless, the cups came out new after scrubbing them.

These little "baking dishes" are also perfect for steaming flan and any other cup appropriate dessert like cupcakes.

Unfortunately, I am dissapointed that they are so small. I need about six of these little guys to make a worthwhile amount of food or dessert.  Each cup comes with a silicone cover that has an air hole to let steam escape.

These come with a limited lifetime warranty free from defects and workmanship.

In summary, these are good but small. Additional cups are needed to be useful. Uncoupling these from the packaging was extremely difficult as the cups stuck together. I store them separately with lids on to avoid this situation in storage. My rating of three stars is due to the high price and small size and quantity of cups that one gets for that price.
